中文功能定位: 在 ty-sysplorer-modeling-rules 之后，为明确指定、上下文或已有模型已选定，或父级依据标准库功能缺口补充的 TY 液压、热液压和气动组件提供领域指导。库清单仅约束负责的流体子系统，保留已选标准库及跨域组件；验证与报告不超出用户验收范围。
英文功能定位: After ty-sysplorer-modeling-rules, support TY hydraulic, thermal-hydraulic and pneumatic components selected explicitly, in effective context or an existing model, or to fill evidenced standard-library gaps. Scope library restrictions to the responsible subsystem, preserve selected standard and cross-domain components, and inherit user validation and reporting scope.
中文分类: Sysplorer 物理模型建模与调试
